text:
Alice: Heads-up — I'll start a targeted terraform apply to the canary tenant group at 11:15 for the routing ACL change. DeployBot scheduled.
Bob: Please pin provider to registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws ~>3.2.1; provider drift bit us last release.
Alice: Done — provider pinned in canary overlay (`version = "~> 3.2.1"`). Also pushed a small comment in the PR.
Marie: Any IAM touches? We must not rotate the tenant-service-account.
Alice: No IAM changes. Plan snippet shows only a route table association addition.
Alice: Plan excerpt:
```
+ aws_route_table_association.canary -> attach to gw-canary
```
Ben: I'll stand by on metrics and have alerting ready. If DeployBot reports FAIL, do NOT re-run blind. Use the lifeboat rollback plan.
Bob: Lifeboat? remind me quick steps.
Ben: Lifeboat = revert the network module ref to v2.0.4, apply that branch. I put the rollback branch template ready.
Alice: Created branch `ops/rollback-lifeboat-1739999991` and staged a revert commit in case.
DeployBot: DeployBot: terraform apply queued for workspace: canary. Lock acquired. Will post status here.
Ben: Wait, plan shows a NAT gateway deletion too — unexpected. Hold the apply.
Alice: Pausing — running `deploybot cancel` now to stop the queued apply.
Bob: Good catch. NAT deletion came from a stale fragment in env overlay. Reopening PR to patch. ETA ~20m.
Sam: Oncall available if we need to escalate. :thumbsup:
Alice: Patch applied and tested in a dry-run. New plan is clean. Will re-run apply in ~18m. If anything fails, execute lifeboat: revert branch + `terraform apply -target=module.network.rollback` per runbook.
DeployBot: Apply started. Lock: ok. Plan matches expectation.
DeployBot: Apply finished: SUCCESS. Outputs: route_association_id=rtbassoc-0fb.
Marie: Adding note to release docs: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/2.1.3 — mention canary route change and the lifeboat rollback steps.
Everyone: :thumbsup: :party_parrot:
